fields.why: Diagnosed-diabetes prevalence is reported across four ordered age groups (18–34 to ≥65) with the claim that it 'increased with age'.
Rurality is metropolitan vs nonmetropolitan (2 groups), so only age has 3 or more groups.
No trend or omnibus test across age groups is stated; the unnamed test behind 'lower ... only among' is metro vs nonmetro within age groups (pairs), so the flag is a false alarm.
